title: A browser sign-in in Settings › AI accounts says, before the sign-in page opens, that the browser will show a cannot-be-reached page and that its address is what to paste
steps: S1: run the tracy-model-plan accounts-pane tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/seat-plan doors): pick ChatGPT Codex, press Connect now, read the panel.
expect: The panel title is 'Waiting for ChatGPT Codex…' and Cancel stays in the panel row.
Under it, ol[data-steps='browser-callback'] holds three li in the order open, refused, copy; the 'Open sign-in page' link (data-action='reopen', href = the authorize URL) sits inside step 1.
Step 2 says the browser will show a page that cannot be reached (localhost refused to connect) and that this is expected.
Step 3 holds an aria-hidden address-bar drawing whose text contains localhost:1455/auth/callback?code=….
Every step comes before the paste box (form.tv-ob-paste); the pasted address still goes to connect/complete and connects the account.

tests: a browser sign-in says what happens before the page opens: three steps in order, the refused page announced, then the paste box
a browser sign-in opens the page and offers the callback URL field; the pasted URL completes it
a wrong callback URL shows its error in the panel with Try again, and Try again starts that vendor again

fence: the order of the browser-sign-in panel: what the browser will show is said before the person opens the page, and the paste box comes after every step
